ThreadSetupFailureCode.description:
Failure categories exposed by asynchronous thread setup.

These values intentionally avoid carrying provider errors, paths, prompts, tool data, or other setup details across the client boundary.

description: A sanitized asynchronous thread setup status.

oneOf.description: Setup has started but has not reached a terminal state.
oneOf.title: Pendingv2::ThreadSetupStatus

oneOf.description: Setup completed and resolved the canonical thread and host identities.
Setup stopped without exposing its internal failure details.
